* '''Playtest''' ([[Invisible Hand: Hallway 328 (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Text: Light Side: “You move to here using landspeed for free.” Dark Side: “If you occupy, opponent must use +1 Force to move from here using landspeed.”
* '''Original''' ([[Invisible Hand: Hallway 328]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-invisiblehandhallway328-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/invisiblehandhallway328.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “You move to here using landspeed for free.” Dark Side: “If you occupy, opponent must use +1 Force to move from here using landspeed.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics; the art credit “Image courtesy to Andrew Price” became “Image courtesy of Andrew Price” and the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added; same words.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 2 August 2019): Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-invisiblehandhallway328-20190802-d24ffc3.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/invisiblehandhallway328.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “You move to here using landspeed for free.” Dark Side: “If you occupy, opponent must use +1 Force to move from here using landspeed.” '''What changed:''' the image was re-uploaded on release day turned 90° (stored as a landscape site card, Holotable commit “Flipped sites”); same picture and words. Listed as its own version under Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026 (18:48: every published image that differs from the previous one is a version).
